sources.entry: Paperless-ngx - Scan, index, and archive all of your paper documents with an improved interface (fork of Paperless). (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 Python/Docker

summary.one_liner: Paperless-ngx is a self-hosted document management system that turns scanned paper documents into a searchable online archive.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Paperless-ngx as a document management system that converts physical documents into a searchable online archive. It is the official successor to the original Paperless and Paperless-ng projects. The easiest deployment path described is docker compose, with example files in /docker/compose that pull the image from the GitHub container registry. An install script is offered to set up a docker compose environment. Migration from Paperless-ng is described as dropping in the new docker image. A full feature list and screenshots are said to live in the external documentation, which the README does not detail further. A public demo is available, and the README notes that demo content is reset frequently.
use_cases: store tax records and invoices digitally
how_to_run: bash -c "$(curl -L ...)" (install script to configure a docker compose environment; URL truncated in README)
Use the compose files in /docker/compose (pull image from GitHub container registry)
Follow the documentation for alternative installation methods
notable: Official successor to Paperless and Paperless-ng
Docker compose deployment with prebuilt images from GitHub container registry
Migration from Paperless-ng by swapping the docker image
Community-run project with teams for frontend, CI/CD and translation via Crowdin
caveats: README warns it should never be run on an untrusted host because data is stored in clear text without encryption
Demo content is reset frequently and confidential data should not be uploaded to it
